Dynamic profile access (own profile vs. other users)

development_notes.css_organization: All CSS moved to external style.css file
development_notes.inline_css_avoidance: No inline CSS should be added to HTML templates
development_notes.accessibility: ARIA labels and keyboard navigation support
development_notes.performance: Optimized database queries and efficient rendering

safety: Do not perform external network calls without explicit authorization
development_practices: Run the test suite after non-trivial changes and commit only passing changes
Do not modify existing tests to make changes pass unless requested
Prefer minimal, incremental diffs with clear commit messages
communication: Include a short summary for each automated change
Provide reproducible commands (PowerShell) to run tests and verification steps
Ask at most one clarifying question if essential
privacy: Avoid printing or logging user-sensitive data
Redact any secrets in messages or logs
security: Enforce permission and validation checks server-side
When adding dependencies, update requirements manifest and explain the reason

when_to_use: Adding new features to the stock management system
Adding new kit types or user fields

coding_standards.python: Follow PEP 8, use Django best practices
coding_standards.html: Use Django template tags, semantic HTML5
coding_standards.css: Use external style.css file, follow BEM naming
coding_standards.javascript: Vanilla JS, avoid jQuery unless necessary

ai_usage_guidelines.testing: Test all features thoroughly before deployment
ai_usage_guidelines.documentation: Update this AI guide when making significant changes
